cases.question: How do I add a parcel to a collection?
cases.expected_behavior: Start at Home > Collections, open a collection, tap Add parcel, enter a title, and Save. Describe expected parcel appearance.

cases.question: Can this app track packages with my carrier automatically?
cases.expected_behavior: State that carrier tracking is planned, not available in fictional version 1.0.0.
forbidden_claims: Turn on live tracking in Settings

cases.question: What should I do when I see Title required?
cases.expected_behavior: Explain that a blank title prevents save, then enter nonblank title and retry; verify the parcel is present.

cases.question: How can I export a backup without deleting my parcels?
cases.expected_behavior: Follow Settings > Export backup and Android document picker; explain that export does not delete local parcels and may contain private notes.

cases.question: How can I sync my parcels across my tablets?
cases.expected_behavior: Explain that fictional v1.0.0 has no multi-device sync; do not invent an account or automatic backup.
